quotes.verbatim_quote:
What should we name this configuration: C D E ?

C Major 9 (no 5, no 7)

D minor 9 (no 3, no 7)

E minor 7 (no 3, no 5, add b6)

F Major 7 (no Root, no 3, add 6)
G7 sus4 (no Root, no 7, add 6)
Aminor 7 (sus 4, no Root, no 7)

B minor 7 ( b5, no Root, no 5, no 7, add bo, sus4)
quotes.why_load_bearing: Demonstrates the naming complexity problem for 3-part spread clusters by listing all valid interpretations of a single three-note set, motivating the author's shorthand solution.
